question: Does removal of final-readout centering improve the retained 1200-update subword MLA recipe at fixed LR0.00125, with epsilon and both affine parameters matched?

architecture_review.selected: Final affine LayerNorm versus affine RMS with bias, epsilon1e-5 in both arms; all eight pre-branch RMSNorms unchanged
architecture_review.correction: Previous deferred wording incorrectly called the incumbent final readout RMSNorm. Actual frozen contract requires affine LayerNorm epsilon1e-5; accepted-model read-only inspection is required in component001. No completed campaign implementation is changed.
architecture_review.rationale: Isolates centering at the readout while keeping parameter count, scale, bias, initialization and epsilon equal. Earlier block LayerNorm negative results are an adverse prior at another placement, not evidence of a final-only gain; no scores or seeds pooled.
